one_time_products.title: Remove Ads
one_time_products.description: Permanently removes banner and interstitial ads. Optional videos (free revive, free coins, boosters) stay available whenever you want them.

one_time_products.title: 100 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 100 coins. Spend coins on Rotate and Refresh boosters, Bombs, revive hearts and new glaze themes.

one_time_products.title: 400 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 400 coins. Spend coins on Rotate and Refresh boosters, Bombs, revive hearts and new glaze themes.

one_time_products.title: 800 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 800 coins, a great-value pack for Rotate and Refresh boosters, Bombs, revive hearts and new glaze themes.

one_time_products.title: 2000 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 2000 coins, the largest pack with the most coins per dollar. Spend them on boosters, Bombs, hearts and glaze themes.

one_time_products.title: 5 Hearts
one_time_products.description: Refills your hearts to the full 5. A heart revives a run that has run out of room (up to 2 heart revives per run).

one_time_products.title: 1hr Unlimited Hearts
one_time_products.description: For one hour, heart revives cost nothing (still up to 2 per run), so a long session never stops at No room.

one_time_products.title: Unlimited Hearts
one_time_products.description: Heart revives never cost a heart again (up to 2 per run). One-time purchase.

one_time_products.title: 10 Bombs
one_time_products.description: Adds 10 Bombs. A Bomb blasts any 3×3 square of the board to make room, and the strongest spot is highlighted for you.

one_time_products.title: Starter Pack
one_time_products.description: 100 coins + 5 Bombs + 5 revive hearts + Ads Off, bundled for new players. One-time purchase.

subscriptions.title: Season Pass
subscriptions.description: Monthly pass: ad-free play, +100 coins every day, all glaze themes unlocked, and unlimited Bombs, Rotates and Refreshes. Cancel anytime in Google Play.

subscriptions.title: Weekly Pass
subscriptions.description: Weekly pass: ad-free play, +50 coins every day, all glaze themes unlocked, and unlimited Bombs, Rotates and Refreshes. Cancel anytime in Google Play.
